paragraphs.text: The Amonkhet block is composed of the large expansion Amonkhet ( ) and the small expansion Hour of Devastation ( ). It was released in 2017.
The annex set Archenemy: Nicol Bolas is not considered to be part of the block.
The Masterpiece Series set for this block is Amonkhet Invocations ( ).
Amonkhet block has one 3-colored Planeswalker deck and three bi-colored Planeswalker decks.
Amonkhet Remastered is a remastered set, containing cards from both Amonkhet and Hour of Devastation . It was digitally released on MTG Arena on August 13, 2020.
